summary_en: ACDT #72 showed bal-devnet-3 still waiting on client readiness. VitalikButerin continued with the strawmap's execution layer, proposing a vectorized math precompile as a valuable short term upgrade. pcaversaccio said transacting privately on Ethereum carries far too much operational overhead. The agenda for the first EIP-8141 frame transaction headliner breakout was posted. chunter-cb submitted EIP-8130 revisions.
